title: auto-save: print staged-file notice to stderr
description: Agents get confused when TASKS.md appears in a commit they did not stage it into, and try to unstage/remove it. auto-delete already prints 'md: removed closed task N' to stderr, but auto-save stages silently (cmd/md/auto_save.go runFromHook). Print a line like 'md: auto-staged TASKS.md' so the inclusion is visible and agents stop fighting the hook.
